ValidationRule.description: Changed to API and Admin to handle IsActive changes
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.Name = "Service Account", RecordType.Name = "C3 Provider" ), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), $Profile.Name <> "API Only User", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not authorized to change the Account Owner. This field can only be modified by the API Only User.
